name: 18702 · Wilkes Barre, PA
findings: ZIP 18702 (Wilkes Barre) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18702 (Wilkes Barre) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 18702 (Wilkes Barre) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
